title: Spec Pack
summary: Cross-phase bundle for turning a game idea into a structured design and implementation spec.
when_to_use: Use this when you need to align direction, lock the gameplay frame, and turn it into an executable implementation plan.
required_inputs: Target players, market, and reference titles
Core loop assumptions and economy goals
starter_steps: Start with direction framing and core loop definition.
Resolve the economy and scope assumptions before implementation detail.
Turn the approved design into a technical spec and HUD structure.
Finish with MVP trimming and implementation review.
